secrets.name: LVBT_EVENTS_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Authenticates signed server events sent to the collector.
steps: Open the existing lvbt-analytics-events Worker in the LVBT Cloudflare account and review Settings → Variables and Secrets.
If LVBT_EVENTS_SECRET already exists, preserve it and the server clients that use it; rotate only through the approved maintainer process.
If the secret is missing, obtain the approved signing credential from the maintainer responsible for authenticated server events, then paste it into the setup prompt.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
secrets.purpose: Identifies the account for the existing production release environment and isolated preview environment.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Publishes reviewed collector versions from the existing production environment.
steps: Review the existing approved collector deployment token and verify it has the permissions intended for production publishing in the declared account.
Preserve a token already stored in the production environment; replace it only through the maintainer's approved rotation process.
If the environment secret is missing, copy the approved token from the maintainer credential store and paste it into the setup prompt.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Uploads and activates only reviewed collector preview versions using a credential independent of the production deployment token.
steps: Review the approved deployment permissions for the separate lvbt-analytics-events-preview Worker in the declared LVBT account.

Preserve an existing collector-preview environment token. If none exists, obtain a separately approved preview deployment credential through the maintainer process; do not copy the production deployment token.
Copy the approved preview token from its credential store and paste it into this scope-specific setup prompt.

secrets.name: CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID
secrets.purpose: Identifies the service credential authorized to verify the isolated collector preview.
steps: Open the LVBT Zero Trust account and review the service token authorized by the collector preview Access application's service-auth policy.
Use the approved token scoped to the preview Worker and version preview hostnames; do not reuse an unrelated production service credential.
Copy its client ID and paste it into the setup prompt.

secrets.name: CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Authorizes identity and health verification through the isolated collector preview Access application.
steps: Review the approved collector preview service token with the maintainer who owns its Access policy.
Preserve the existing service token and policy; create or rotate a credential only through the maintainer's approved process.
Copy its stored client secret and paste it into the setup prompt.

variables.name: LVBT_PREVIEW_URL
variables.purpose: The reviewed isolated collector HTTPS origin behind Cloudflare Access.

variables.name: LVBT_PREVIEW_BINDINGS
variables.purpose: The explicit public preview binding descriptor selecting a distinct dataset and rate-limit namespace, plus a secret declaration without its value.
